name: Bio Green Med Solution Inc.
summary: Bio Green Med Solution, Inc. (BGMS) operates as a multifaceted company, with active involvement in both the fire protection and biopharmaceutical industries. The organization recently broadened its capabilities by completing the acquisition of Fitters Sdn. Bhd., a Malaysian firm known for its fire safety products and services. BGMS is committed to driving progress in biopharmaceutical research and developing cutting-edge fire safety solutions, striving to deliver enduring value to its investors.
